name: Torrent Hand
description: Throw an open palm forward with a rushing sheet of water qi that hits like a thrown bucket.

name: Rush Guard
description: Fold a rushing skin of qi around the forearms so a heavy blow is dispersed along their length.

name: Torrent Step
description: Burst forward three paces with a jet of water qi from the rear heel to shove the body ahead.

name: Rush Mend
description: Flush a quick rush of healing water qi through an ally's cut thigh to knit the muscle and stop the blood.

name: Rushing Lash
description: Lash a whipping stream of qi across the opponent's guard arm so the strike lands and the arm is thrown wide.

name: Surging Sheet
description: Hold a surging sheet of water qi in front of the body that shoves back each blow that meets it.

name: Torrent Crash
description: Gather the full weight of a torrent into one downward palm so it crashes through a raised guard and the body behind it.

name: Plunging Torrent
description: Drop a torrent of water qi from above onto the opponent so the strike lands and the opponent's own qi is driven down.

name: Flood Fist
description: Punch straight out with the body behind the blow and a flood of water qi released at the knuckles.

name: Flood Guard
description: Plant the stance low and let a heavy layer of water qi fill the arms and take the impact.

name: Flood Step
description: Press forward in short sliding steps so the whole body arrives as one rising mass of water qi.

name: Brimming Salve
description: Fill an ally's torn shoulder with brimming water qi that swells the flesh back to shape.

name: Flood Press
description: Lean a flood of qi onto the opponent's chest so the strike lands and the breath is pressed out.

name: Rising Flood
description: Raise the water qi under the opponent's feet so the footing floats away while the user steps in.

name: Flood Break
description: Break an incoming blow apart with a flood of qi from the forearm and strike through the gap.

name: Flood Rend
description: Drive the whole weight of a flood through the palm to tear apart a shield rim or a braced arm in one blow.

name: Drowning Flood
description: Pour a wide flood of water qi over the nearby opponents until they stagger breathless and half blind.

name: Breaker Palm
description: Break a wave of qi across the target with an open palm so the force spreads over the chest.

name: Breaker Ward
description: Let the qi field round the body break against an attack and turn its force along the surface.

name: Breaker Step
description: Ride the leading edge of the field forward in a long smooth step that gains a full body length.

name: Bathing Mend
description: Spread the qi field over an ally so the wounded body is bathed in slow healing water qi.

name: Surge Strike
description: Surge the whole qi field forward so the strike lands and nearby opponents are shoved off balance.

name: Flowing Skin
description: Thicken the qi field to a flowing liquid skin that thins the force of every strike that crosses it.

name: Breaker Wave
description: Send the field outward in one great breaker that rolls over everyone near the user and knocks them down.

name: Standing Breaker
description: Hold the field as a standing breaker that stops every blow at its edge and presses the qi of those who strike.

name: Cascade Palm
description: Bring a palm down in a falling arc so a thin cascade of water qi follows it onto the target.

name: Cascade Ward
description: Let a falling sheet of qi pour down the guard arm and carry a strike off to the ground.

name: Cascade Step
description: Drop down a stair of ground or air on falling water qi and land without a jar.

name: Mending Spray
description: Spray a fine mist of healing qi over several grazed allies so the shallow wounds close at once.

name: Cascade Listen
description: Let a thin fall of qi run over a patient's chest and read from its sound the breath and the pulse.

name: Cleansing Cascade
description: Pour a cascade of water qi over an ally to wash out a poison or a clinging taint.

name: Rousing Spray
description: Dash a spray of bright water qi across a dazed ally's face to wake the mind and quicken the limbs.

name: Cascade Weave
description: Weave falling strands of qi into a curtain before the wounded so blows drip away from them.

name: Reviving Cascade
description: Pour a deep cascade of water qi over a person whose breath has just stopped to restart the heart within a few breaths.

name: Mending Cataract
description: Let a great fall of water qi close deep wounds on several allies and strip the taint from them.

name: Twin Ripple
description: Strike with both palms a half beat apart so two ripples of qi meet inside the target's chest.

name: Twin Film
description: Hold two films of water qi one behind the other so the second catches what the first lets through.

name: Duo Slide
description: Take two quick steps down two tracks of qi so the body is never where the first attack lands.

name: Twin Salve
description: Rest a healing hand on each side of an ally's wound and draw the edges together with paired currents.

name: Paired Current
description: Send one current to bind the guard arm and a second to strike the ribs it was covering.

name: Dual Wash
description: Wash an attack aside with the left hand and return a washing blow to the attacker with the right.

name: Twin Rush
description: Surge forward on one current and strike on the second as the body arrives.

name: Twin Torrent
description: Throw two torrents of water qi from both palms to meet at one point and burst there.

name: Paired Flood
description: Send a flood down each flank at once so that opponents on both sides are caught and swept together.

name: Azure Wavelet
description: Strike with a palm glowing pale blue with water qi that rings against the target's guard.

name: Hawk Dive
description: Drop from a half crouch onto the target with the arms folded and water qi leading the shoulder.

name: Azure Film
description: Spread a pale blue veil of qi over the body that softens a strike before it reaches the skin.

name: Hawk Skim
description: Skim low across the ground on spread arms and a thin layer of water qi under the feet.

name: Azure Balm
description: Smooth a pale blue film of healing qi over an ally's burn or bruise until the colour returns.

name: Blue Crest
description: Throw up a crest of qi that turns a strike skyward and cuts down across the exposed arm.

name: Hawk Plunge
description: Dive from a leap with the whole weight behind a spear of water qi and drive it through the guard.

name: Azure Deluge
description: Call a deluge of pale blue water qi down on the nearby opponents in a single dropping sheet.

name: Return Palm
description: Send the palm out with a flow of qi and draw the flow back to the hand as the blow lands.

name: Return Guard
description: Catch a strike on the wrist and let the force run up and down the arm back toward its sender.

name: Return Step
description: Step out along a line of qi and step back along the same line before the opponent can close.

name: Return Mend
description: Draw an ally's scattered life qi back toward a torn limb with a slow returning flow.

name: Flowing Reply
description: Take a blow into a film of qi and answer with a strike built from the same borrowed force.

name: Round Wash
description: Wash a strike round the body in a full circle that leaves the attacker spun and off balance.

name: Reflux Strike
description: Hold the qi of a blocked strike in the arm for a beat and loose it back through the attacker's frame.

name: Rebound Tide
description: Hold a wide ebbing tide before the body that flings each strike back with the weight it brought.

name: Rain Palm
description: Bring a palm down like falling rain with a quick hard patter of water qi into the target's shoulder.

name: Rain Ward
description: Hang a curtain of fine rain-like qi before the body that blunts what is thrown through it.

name: Rain Step
description: Move in light quick steps that leave no sound as a drizzle on a roof.

name: Sworn Dew
description: Bead dew on an ally's wound by oath and let the sworn water qi close the skin.

name: Rain Lash
description: Flick a stinging lash of rain-like qi across the face to blind and break the opponent's rhythm.

name: Oathrain Wash
description: Call a sworn rain over a poisoned ally to wash the venom through the skin and out.

name: Falling Veil
description: Draw a veil of falling water qi round the body that thickens as the strikes grow heavy.

name: Rain Hammer
description: Gather the rain into one hammering fist and drop it on the target in a single heavy blow.

name: Gathering Rain
description: Gather rain-laden qi overhead for a few breaths and loose it onto the nearby opponents all at once.

name: Placid Palm
description: Take a bearing on the target's centre and drive a straight palm along it without a wasted motion.

name: Heading Guard
description: Hold a steady film of qi along the line the opponent faces so strikes slide off before they land.

name: Tide Stride
description: Step along the chosen bearing and hold it however the opponent shifts.

name: Breath Bearing
description: Read the water in an unseen opponent's breath and hold the direction of the body that breathes it.

name: Course Mend
description: Run healing water qi along an ally's wounded limb from the root to the tip and seal it.

name: Steady Tide
description: Press a steady tide of qi along the bearing so the strike lands and the opponent's qi slows.

name: Bearing Press
description: Lean along the bearing so the opponent is driven back a full step and struck as the foot lands.

name: Tide Course
description: Run a straight course on a flowing tide of qi and strike the target at the end of the run.

name: Onward Tide
description: Drive a deep tide of water qi straight along the bearing and through whatever stands on it.

name: Heading Surge
description: Surge across the field along the bearing in one bound and strike the target as the body lands.

name: Vow Ripple
description: Strike openly with a palm of water qi in plain sight and let the force prove the oath.

name: Unwalled Guard
description: Spread a flowing film of qi with no fixed edge so a blow finds nothing solid to break.

name: Unbound Step
description: Walk across open ground on a loose current of qi with no cover and no hurry.

name: Oathwater Mend
description: Speak an oath to an ally's wound and let sworn water qi flow in to close it.

name: Oath Listen
description: Spread a thin field of water qi and learn where every wounded ally within it lies.

name: Oath Wash
description: Wash a sworn ally clean of poison or binding with a patient flow of water qi.

name: Open Current
description: Send an open current straight at the opponent so the strike lands and the stance is shoved apart.

name: Unwalled Tide
description: Hold a wide soft tide round the user and nearby allies that gives under blows and then gives them back.

name: Oath Flood
description: Release a held flood of water qi across the field in one sworn surge that sweeps the nearby opponents back.

name: Oath Revival
description: Kneel by a fallen ally whose breath has just stopped and pour sworn water qi in to start it again.
